title: पहिराे खसेपछि घोराही–होलेरी सडक खण्ड अवरुद्ध
article_text:
दाङ – दाङको घोराहीबाट रोल्पाको होलेरी जोड्ने सडक अवरुद्ध भएको छ।

लगातार पानी परिरहेका कारण पहाडबाट खसेको पहिरोले सडक अवरुद्ध गरेको दाङका प्रमुख जिल्ला अधिकारी रामबहादुर कुरुम्वाङले जानकारी दिए।

बिहान साढे ७ बजे तिर घोराही उपमहानगरपालिका–१३ काभ्रेमा पहिरो खसेको हो।

अहिले पहिरो हटाउन सुरक्षाकर्मी परिचालन गरिएको छ। अविरल वर्षाका कारण दाङबाट छिमेकी जिल्ला जोड्ने सडकमा पहिरो खस्दा सडक अवरुद्ध हुँदै आएको छ।

title: मध्यपहाडी लोकमार्ग र बागलुङ-म्याग्दी सडक अवरुद्ध
article_text:
काठमाडाैँ- निरन्तरको वर्षाका कारण बागलुङका दुई ठूला राजमार्ग अवरुद्ध भएका छन्।

राष्ट्रिय गौरवको आयोजनाका रूपमा रहेको मध्यपहाडी पुष्पलाल लोकमार्गको गलकोटबाठ बुर्तिबाङ खण्ड र बागलुङबाट म्याग्दी जाने सडक पहिराले पूर्णरूपमा अवरुद्ध बनाएको हा‍े।

लोकमार्गअन्तर्गत गलकोट नगरपालिका र ढोरपाटन नगरपालिकाको तुरतुरेमा पहिरो खस्दा सडक अवरुद्ध भएको जिल्ला प्रहरी कार्यालय बागलुङका सूचना अधिकारी प्रहरी नायब उपरीक्षक इन्द्रबहादुर रानाले जानकारी दिए।

तुरतुरेमा बर्सेनि पहिरो खस्ने गरेको छ। वर्षात्ले गलकोट नगरपालिका-१ दुदिलाभाटी र २ नरेठाँटी क्षेत्रमा समेत सडक क्षतविक्षत बनाएको छ।

यस्तै, बागलुङबाट म्याग्दी जिल्ला जोड्ने मुख्य सडकसमेत पहिराले अवरुद्ध बनाएको छ। बागलुङ नगरपालिका-४ र म्याग्दीको बेनी नगरपालिका-१ को सिमानास्थित डम्मरेखोला नजिकै पहिरो खस्दा सडक अवरुद्ध भएको छ। निरन्तर पानी परिरहेकाले सडक खुलाउन समस्या भएको छ।

पृथ्वीराजमार्गको आँबुखैरेनी-मुग्लिन खण्ड अवरुद्ध

मंगलबार रातिदेखि परेको वर्षाका कारण पहिरो जाँदा पृथ्वीराजमार्गअन्तर्गत तनहुँको आँबुखैरेनी-मुग्लिन सडकखण्ड अवरुद्ध भएको छ। आँबुखैरेनी गाउँपालिका-२ स्थित ऐनापहरामा पहिरो जाँदा आज बिहानदेखि उक्त सडकखण्ड अवरुद्ध भएको हो।

पहिरोले उक्त सडकखण्ड दुईतर्फी अवरुद्ध भएको जिल्ला प्रहरी कार्यालय तनहुँका प्रहरी नायब उपरीक्षक युवराज तिमिल्सिनाले जानकारी दिए। पहिरो पन्छाएर राजमार्ग सञ्चालन गराउने काम भइरहेको खड्काले बताए।

title: At least 14 dead in Ilam landslides – Nepal Press
article_text:
KATHMANDU : At least 14 people died after being buried in landslides in Ilam.

According to Chief District Officer, Sunita Nepal, five persons died in Maijogmai Rural Municipality-5, six in Ilam Municipality-6 and three in Mangsebung Rural Municipality-1.

Police personnel have headed towards the incident sites.

Locals have been carrying out rescue operations and the number of landslide victims might increase.

Meanwhile, nine people have gone missing in landslides, according to Armed Police Force.

title: 17 killed in landslides in Ilam - OnlineKhabar English News
article_text:
Home » Nature » Disaster » 17 killed in landslides in Ilam

Kathmandu, October 5

At least 17 people have been killed in landslides triggered by floods in Ilam district. Human casualties have been reported mostly in Ilam Municipality, Suryodaya Municipality, Deumai Municipality, Mangsebung Rural Municipality, and Phakphokthum Rural Municipality.

In Ilam Municipality-6, Ghos, six members of the family of Dambar Bahadur Tamang were killed after their house was buried by a landslide. A rescue team from the Armed Police Force’s Shree Antu Battalion was deployed to the site.

Similarly, in Suryodaya Municipality-1, Manebhanjyang, five people were killed when a landslide swept away the house of Raju Chhetri. Four bodies were recovered from the debris, while one injured person died on the way to hospital. A seven-member rescue team under the command of Armed Police Sub-Inspector Surendra Dotel was mobilized in the area.

In Deumai Municipality-5, Ghuseini, a landslide buried the house of Deepak Limbu, killing two people. Three others remain missing, while one person was rescued safely.

Likewise, in Mangsebung Rural Municipality-5, three people died when a landslide struck the house of Madan Limbu.

Police also confirmed that in Phakphokthum Rural Municipality-3, Ratomate, 32-year-old Suresh Limbu was killed after being buried by a landslide.

Kathmandu, September 13

At least three persons have died in different incidents of landslides in Bahrabise municipality of Sindhupalchok, around 85 kilometres northeast of Kathmandu, in the wee hours of Sunday.

Whereas security personnel have recovered bodies of Bhakti Maya Shrestha (65) of Nagpuje, Junu Maya BK (23) of Bhirkharke, and Sarkini Newar (60) of Newar Tole, at least 28 others are missing, informs DSP Prakash Sapkota of Sindhupalchok District Polie Office.

Many houses have been buried in the landslides in these three places lying in Bahrabise-7 after incessant rainfall last night. DSP Sapkota says locals have reported destruction of 11 houses so far.

Personnel of Nepal Police, Nepal Army, and Armed Police Force have launched a rescue operation.

Meanwhile, House of Representatives Speaker Agni Prasad Sapkota, who represents a constituency of the district in the House, has gone to the landslide-hit areas this morning.

title: Landslides leave Ilam reeling after deadly October rains - OnlineKhabar English News
article_text:
Home » Cover » Landslides leave Ilam reeling after deadly October rains

Mangal Bahadur Limbu, who drives an auto-rickshaw in Biblyante Bazaar, Ilam, had a dream of building a house near the market.

After years of hard work, he bought a plot of land just below the Mechi Highway and began constructing his home. However, the continuous rainfall on October 4 and 5, followed by landslides, has reduced that dream to rubble.

Landslides have struck both above and below his under-construction house.

“I had already spent a lot. If the landslide hadn’t occurred, we would have been living in the new house by now,” he says. “Now everything is uncertain.”

He is deeply worried as the property he built through hardship has been caught in the grip of landslides right before his eyes.

Mangal Bahadur is just a representative case. Ilam , once known as the “queen of hills,” has now been devastated by landslides.

The floods and landslides triggered by the heavy rainfall in October caused damage totalling Rs 11.81 billion to roads, bridges, buildings, drinking water systems, irrigation, livestock, and agriculture in Ilam.

A total of 39 people lost their lives, and 26 were injured. The disaster destroyed 365 houses, while 940 houses suffered partial damage.

The government had announced that families whose homes were destroyed would be provided with new houses through the Reconstruction Authority. However, the victims have not yet received the funds needed to begin rebuilding.

According to Chief District Officer Laxman Dhakal, relief funds for flood victims have still not been distributed.

“Funds for temporary housing have been released,” he says, “but the process of providing relief for permanent housing has not yet begun.”

He added that more than 250 affected families have already received funds for temporary housing. The process for permanent housing will begin once temporary housing is completed.

Local governments are currently entering victim data online, which will then be approved by the National Disaster Authority. As per the federal government’s announcement, each affected family will receive Rs 450,000 in three instalments.

According to provincial assembly member and former Minister for Economic Affairs and Planning Ram Rana, a lack of coordination among the three levels of government has delayed relief distribution, leaving victims unsupported even as another monsoon approaches.

“Although the provincial government announced it would build houses, the Reconstruction Authority’s rules require coordination among all three levels of government,” he says. “Due to insufficient coordination, the work has been delayed, and victims have not received relief.”

The Mechi Highway, considered a lifeline connecting Ilam and the eastern hills to the Terai, has now become extremely hazardous. In the Ilam section alone, landslides have occurred at more than 200 locations. From Biblyante northwards, including Rajduwali, the road is highly risky in many places.

The situation in the Rajduwali section is even more alarming, with landslides across the entire stretch. Vehicles are currently operating dangerously on temporary tracks built over the landslides.

According to Arjun Ghimire, information officer at the Road Division Office, Ilam, the problem in Rajduwali is deeper than it appears. A study team has concluded that underground water is the main cause of the landslides there.

Water accumulated inside the hill has weakened the soil, causing landslides. Currently, drilling is being carried out at the base of the hill to drain the water.

“After experts reported that underground water is causing the landslides, work is underway to remove it,” Ghimire says. “Drilling is being done beneath the Rajduwali hill, along the banks of the Mai Khola, to drain the water.”

According to Ghimire, it will take several years to fully restore the damaged road.

“A multi-year plan with a budget of Rs 1.5 billion has been secured, and contracts have been invited,” he added. “Reconstruction work is ongoing in landslide-affected areas.”

Work to control landslides along the Mechi Highway is being carried out in four packages.

Two packages cover the Dhobidhara–Nepaltar section, one covers Bakhkhor–Ranke, and another covers the Phidim section of Panchthar. However, due to the scale of the landslides, immediate control is unlikely, raising the risk of similar hardships in the upcoming monsoon.

With the main highway disrupted, alternative roads connecting Ilam have also been severely affected. In the Danabari–Ilam section, connectivity was cut off after a bridge at Belase collapsed. Efforts are now underway to install a Bailey bridge there.

A diversion has been created in the river for transportation, but even light rainfall causes flooding in the Mai Khola, damaging the diversion and making transport unreliable. Ongoing road construction in the Danabari section has further complicated vehicle movement.

Processes are also underway to install Bailey bridges on the Puwa Khola and Simaldanda–Tilkeni roads. These bridges are being constructed with grant assistance from the Government of India.

The floods and landslides following the heavy rains in October caused total damages worth Rs 11.81 billion in Ilam.

Under the Road Division, 11 projects alone suffered losses of Rs 6.96 billion. The Infrastructure Development Office reported damages of Rs 2.34 billion across 62 roads, Rs 850 million across 25 bridges, and Rs 40 million in six buildings.

Under the Water Resources and Irrigation Development Division, 16 river control projects suffered losses worth Rs 134.69 million, five landslide control projects Rs 17.42 million, and 72 irrigation projects Rs 177.15 million.

A total of 3,409 farmers suffered crop losses across 892.32 hectares, amounting to Rs 274.99 million. Additionally, 25 tea estates under the National Tea and Coffee Development Board’s expansion program incurred damages worth Rs 47.55 million.

Chief District Officer Dhakal acknowledged that post-disaster reconstruction has been slow. He said the Rajduwali section of the Mechi Highway remains at an extremely high risk of landslides, with vehicles still operating over unstable terrain.

He added that alternative routes could be restored once a Bailey bridge is installed on the Belase road section connecting Ilam. According to him, unless the 14 damaged bridges are repaired immediately, there is a risk of further major losses. He said the provincial government has been urged to carry out the repairs.

Adhikari is an Onlinekhabar correspondent based in Biratnagar.

title: People stranded without food and water after Karnali Highway landslide - OnlineKhabar English News
article_text:
Home » Cover » People stranded without food and water after Karnali Highway landslide

Surkhet, April 7

Landslides and floods have taken a heavy toll on parts of the Karnali Highway after heavy rainfall on Saturday night.

Landslides have occurred in Dullu Municipality of Dailekh and Shubh Kalika Rural Municipality of Kalikot, leaving many stranded and without drinking water.

People have been stranded for two days due to delay in clearing the debris.

The excavator had been sent to the landslide site on early Saturday, but it could not reach the place on time. Hence, people have been left waiting for help as the spot doesn’t have clean drinking water nor does it have a place to eat food.

Kalikot’s Chief District Officwer Chandra Bahadur Karki says the landslide has not been cleared due to the continuous rainfall.

He also adds that the landslides are still occurring in the area and that has made it difficult to clear the debris on time.

Nepal Army, Nepal Police and Armed Police Force personnel have been deployed to clear the highway.

article_text:
Home » Cover » Six killed, two injured in Gulmi landslides

Gulmi, July 23

At least six persons died and two others sustained injuries in different incidents of landslide in Gulmi district of western Nepal on Tuesday morning.

Chief District Officer Yadu Nath Paudel confirms that the deaths were reported from wards 3 and 4 of Satyawati rural municipality.

Til Kumari Tramu, 32, and Darshan Tramu, 9, died after a landslide in Kasin Danda, Satyawati-3 buried their house, according to Paudel.

Likewise, the victims in Limgha, Satyawati-4, have been identified as Chhallali BK, 65, Pampha BK, 28, Anjali BK, 12, and Hemanta BK, 10.

Police say they were asleep when the landslide buried their house in the wee hours today.

Karishma Tramu, 10, and Dhani Tramu, 13, are injured.

CDO Paudel says personnel of Nepal Police, Armed Police Force and Nepal Army have been sent to the incident site. They, however, are yet to reach there due to incessant rainfall and landslides.

The incident site is close to the border with Syangja.

title: Traffic obstructed due to landslide on Beni-Jomsom road - OnlineKhabar English News
article_text:
Home » Nature » Disaster » Traffic obstructed due to landslide on Beni-Jomsom road

Myagdi, July 4

Landslides in various places of Raghuganga and Annapurna Rural Municipalities of Myagdi have affected traffic on the Beni-Jomsom road connecting Mustang with the national highway. The locals of Raghuganga and Annapurna Rural Municipality, Mustang, as well as pilgrims and tourists, are stuck in traffic jams for hours due to the landslide.

Landslides in Baisari, Siruwari in Raghuganga and Guithevir of Annapurna Rural Municipality have affected travelling along the road, said Chair of Annapurna Rural Municipality, Bharatkumar Pun. The landslide that took place in Baisari two years ago has occurred.

Last year, a driver was killed in a Baisari landslide. On Tuesday, a van with registration number BA.026 Cha. 7053, which was going from Jomsom to Beni, was buried in the landslide. Meanwhile, there is no possibility of transportation through alternative roads in the landslide-affected areas.

Due to the lack of direct traffic on the 76 kilometres of Beni-Jomsom road, the export of agricultural products including potatoes has been affected. According to Beni-Jomsom-Korala road project manager Dhruvakumar Jha, there are 14 landslide spots along the road.

“There is a problem in working on it due to lack of budget for landslide and erosion prevention”, he said, Chief District Officer Laxman Dhakal, who inspected the site of the Baisari landslide on Wednesday, said that the Department of Road’s equipment, technicians, workers as well as security agencies have been mobilized for short-term control of landslides and resume traffic in the area.

title: Ward offices at risk due to landslides in Solukhumbu, 11 families displaced - OnlineKhabar English News

Home » Nature » Disaster » Ward offices at risk due to landslides in Solukhumbu, 11 families displaced

Solukhumbu, August 10

Ward offices in Solukhumbu are facing a serious threat from landslides, resulting in the displacement of 11 families due to the relentless heavy rainfall. The affected ward offices are located in Tamakhani and Sotang Rural Municipalities in the district. Chief District Officer Kamansing Thapa Margar shared that a landslide struck last Saturday night, jeopardising the Solududhakunda Municipality-3 office, while another landslide hit the Sotang Rural Municipality-4 office just days earlier.

The ongoing rains have also caused minor damage to other government buildings in the area. Notably, a landslide has taken out the toilet facility at the Tamakhani ward office, putting the nearby administration building in jeopardy as well. Ward chair Lhakpagelu Sherpa emphasised the gravity of the situation, noting that a large landslide from the upper hill has already compromised surrounding infrastructure, including roads, and poses a risk of further damage.

He voiced concerns that if the landslide continues to worsen, it could threaten both the ward office and the local health post, making the area increasingly perilous. In Rural Municipality-9, five households have been forced to evacuate and are now staying in a nearby school due to the landslide threat. Additionally, in Likhupike Rural Municipality-3, another family has been relocated for their safety after their home was put at risk. In total, 11 families have been affected by these dangerous conditions.

title: Landslide-blocked Rahughat stream finds outlet but danger not over yet
article_text:
The immediate threat of flood in the Rahughat stream in Raghuganga Rural Municipality-6, Myagdi was averted on Thursday after the dam formed by a landslide was cleared after nine hours of blockage.

“The immediate threat has been averted, as the landslide debris made way for the stream water to flow. However, the stream can be blocked anytime, as the landslide is still running up at Rayokhor cliff,” said Ganesh Bahadur Adhikari, the chief district officer of Myagdi. “Meteorologists have forecast heavy rainfall for some days so the downstream settlements are still at risk of floods and landslides.”

The incident site is about 35 km north-west of Beni, the district headquarters of Myagdi.

According to local residents, the landslide that erupted from Rayokhor area dammed the Rahughat stream, which empties into the Kaligandaki river, at around 5 am on Thursday, forming an artificial lake of around one kilometre long, 20 metres wide and 15 metres deep. Huge boulders dammed the stream that flows in the narrow gorge between wards 6 and 7 of Raghuganga Rural Municipality.

Om Pun, a resident of Chimkhola in Raghuganga-7, told the Post that water started overflowing from the landslide-dammed lake at around 2pm.

Rayokhor is a landslide-prone area. A huge landslide in 2000 had displaced 40 households in a settlement.

A week ago, a landslide in Rayokhor had blocked the stream for half an hour. Similarly, the Rahughat stream had been blocked in Pakhapani area for around six hours three years ago.

Myagdi, a mountain district of Gandaki Province, is prone to floods and landslides. The landslides often fall and block the Rahughat, Myagdi and Kaligandaki—three major rivers in the district—leaving riverside settlements at high risk.

On July 25, a massive landslide blocked the Gurjakhola in Dhawalagiri Rural Municipality-1. Water started flowing out after eight hours but the lake dammed by the debris is still there.

“Riverbed settlements including Beni are at high risk of floods and landslides. Every year, we have to face flood-and-landslide-related disasters ,” said Hari Krishna Shrestha, a local campaigner of the Beni Conservation Campaign. “We are making efforts to protect Beni bazaar and other riverbed settlements from such disasters.”

Badarjung cliff, which lies at the border of Myagdi-Mustang; Guithe cliff at Dana; Tatopani cliff in Bhurung; Nepane cliff in Gharkhola; and Timure cliff in Ghar are at risk of landslides. “If a landslide occurs in any part of these cliffs, Kaligandaki river will be blocked,” said Shrestha.

Like Raghuganga and Kali Gandaki rivers, Myagdi river, which originates from Paschimgurja, Churen and Dhaulagiri Himal, also gets blocked because of floods and landslide debris time and again.

Ghanshyam Khadka is the Myagdi correspondent for Kantipur Publications.

title: Landslide damages two houses in Melamchi
article_text:
A landslide triggered by incessant rains damaged two houses at Melamchi Bazaar in Sindhupalchok district on early Wednesday morning. A parked van and a motorcycle were also buried in the incident.

“Some houses in the area are at high risk after the landslide. Their occupants are looking for a safer place where they can relocate because the landslide has not stopped,” said Mahesh Kumar Shrestha, a local.

Security personnel from the Nepal Police and Armed Police Force were mobilised to clear the debris and salvage the victims’ belongings. “The land just above the Bazaar has caved in. It poses danger to the entire settlement,” said Police Inspector Nabaraj Dhungana.

The landslide has also obstructed traffic movement to Helambu and Kiul, affecting hundreds of people.

title: Nine people die in Timure landslide
article_text:
Nine people died and 12 others sustained injuries in a massive landslide at Timure in Gosaikunda Rural Municipality-2 of Rasuwa district on Wednesday night. Five critically injured people were taken to Kathmandu for treatment.

The landslide triggered by heavy rains buried two huts, a hotel and a temporary police beat at Timure along the Syaphrubeshi-Rasuwagadhi road section. There were no police personnel at the beat when the incident happened. Two containers and a truck were also hit by falling rocks.

The site is about 25 km north of Dhunche, the district headquarters, and about 1.5 km south of the Nepal-China border. Police identified the deceased as Shyam Shrestha, Bikram Shrestha, Mangale Tamang, Resham Khadka of Bhotekoshi Rural Muni-cipality in Sindhupalchok district, Mingmar Gumbu Tamang of Gosaikunda-1, Dorje Wanchuk Ghale and his wife Karsang Kimu Ghale of Gosaikunda-1, Ramesh Tamang of Shivapuri Rural Municipality-8 in Nuwakot and Sharmila Kami of Bidur Municipality-3 of Nuwakot. Five of the deceased were drivers staying at the hotel while Sharmila was a hotel worker. Three other locals also died in the disaster.

The mudslide started above the settlement. Urgen Ghale, a local, told the Post that he had heard a loud bang around midnight. According to him, all the villagers gathered on the Rasuwagadhi Customs Office premises. The local youths started rescue work 20 minutes after the incident, he added.

Personnel from the Nepal Army, Nepal Police and the Armed Police Force had reached the incident site immediately to rescue the victims. They saved 12 people from the debris and provided first aid.

Rescuers pulled the bodies out of the debris on Thursday by using two excavators and a loader.

Meanwhile, Chief District Officer Krishna Poudel said the local administration would provide Rs100,000 for the family of each deceased and Rs10,000 for each victim whose house was destroyed in the landslide.

Balram Ghimire is the Rasuwa correspondent for Kantipur Media Group.

title: Jajarkot landslide: Death toll reaches 9
article_text:
The death toll in a landslide that occurred at Thanti bazaar of Bheri Municipality-3 in Jajarkot on Sunday, has reached nine. One woman and eight children were killed and one person was injured in the natural disaster.

The landslide had buried two houses of Tirtha Raj Bohora and Jit Bahadur Sunar burying 10 people early this morning.

According to the police, Tirtha Raj’s daughter Najita Bohora, 5; Sheetal Luhar, 25, wife of Lal Bahadur Luhar and tenants at Bohora’s house, their daughters Bhagwati, 9, Ranjana, 6 and Manisha,3, were killed in the incident.

Likewise, the landslide also buried Govinda Pariyar, 12 and Dasharath Pariyar, 5, sons of Jit Bahadur Pariyar of of Karuwa, Nalgadh Municipality-3.

Similarly, sons of Prem Bahadur Pariyar of Khurpa of Kushe-5, tenants at Sunar’s house—Narendra Pariyar, 12 and Nabin Pariyar, 10 also died in the landlside.

One Lal Bahadur Lohar, 35, was rescued alive 90 minutes after he was buried. He has been receiving treatment at Jajarkot hospital.

Personnel from Nepal Police, Nepal Army, Armed Police Force and locals are carrying out the rescue works. Police said 17 houses are in danger of landslide in the area.

title: Monsoon brings more misery to Dhading villages
article_text:
Netra Prasad Khand, 55, died on the night of June 9 when his house got swept away by a landslide while he was asleep. His wife Kanmaya Khand was staying at the new house the couple had built after the 2015 earthquake damaged their old house.

Continuous rainfall in the preceding week followed by heavy rainfall on June 9 triggered the landslide at Agnichok in Tripura Sundari Rural Municipality-5, Dhading that killed Netra.

“It was raining heavily that night. Loose stones and boulders were rolling down the hill. It soon turned into a mudslide and then a full-fledged landslide,” said 55-year-old Kanmaya. “I screamed for my husband who had gone to sleep in our old house but the storm drowned out my screams.”

About two hours later, the neighbours heard Kanmaya’s call for help and went to rescue the couple. “But my husband was already buried in the landslide,” she said.

Netra’s body was recovered from the landslide debris the next day. He is survived by his wife and son, who had gone to Korea for foreign employment a month and a half before the disaster.

Eighty-four-year-old Dhanmaya Sarki also died in a landslide last Thursday at Budhathum, Gangajamuna Rural Municipality-7.

Incessant rainfall since last week has affected several settlements in Gangajmuna and Tripura Sundari rural municipalities. Every year, monsoon brings about loss of lives, displacement of people, and destruction of property in the area.

Around 62 houses have been swept away by landslides while 217 houses have been damaged in Gangajamuna Rural Municipality this month alone. There was one casualty .

In Tripura Sundari Municipality, landslides have killed one person and damaged nearly 161 houses this year.

According to Tul Kumari BK, 55, of Bhirmauri in Gangajamuna Rural Municipality-5, her house was badly damaged in a landslide on June 14. She has moved out of her house and is currently taking shelter at her neighbour’s property.

“I have pitched a tent in my neighbour’s field because our house is badly damaged. The threat of being swept away by landslides compelled us to leave our house,” she said.

Most settlements in Gangajamuna and Tripura Sundari rural municipalities were greatly affected by the 2015 earthquakes with most houses either completely or partially damaged.

People living in the damaged houses haven’t been at peace since the earthquake, says BK.

“The earthquake has left the landmass here with huge cracks and loose soil,” said BK. “Every rainy season is a curse for us. When it rains, we have no choice but to sit and wait for the disaster to pass.”

The settlements are now dotted with concrete houses alongside the old damaged ones but the locals say that even the new structures face the risk of being swept away or buried by landslides.

“The topography has become weak since 2015 so even if we build concrete houses, it’s not going to help us survive a landslide,” said Bal Bahadur Bhandari of Chhapathok in Tripura Sundari Rural Municipality-6. “We haven’t been able to sleep since the monsoons began. It has been this way since 2015. Some of us are currently living under a tarpaulin tent while others have gone to their relatives.”

The Nepal Red Cross Society, Dhading, in collaboration with the District Administration Office and the rural municipal office has provided tarpaulin, appliances, blankets and food to the landslide-displaced families.

Landslides have damaged crops, livestock and food and swept away property in several wards of Gangajamuna and Tripura Sundari rural municipalities.

On July 21, 2019, an entire settlement of 92 individuals from 21 households in Bahrabise of Gajuri Rural Municipality-2 was displaced by a landslide. The landslide-displaced families have been demanding the government for safe relocation but the authorities have yet to address their demands.

The rural municipality has allotted a leased property for the landslide-displaced to settle in but the victims say it is not the solution they are looking for.

“In 2019, our settlement got swept away by a landslide. At first, we took shelter in the house of a relative but after some time, we moved to the leased land provided by the municipality and put up a tent there,” said Sun Bahadur Tamang of Bahrabise in Gajuri Rural Municipality-2. “I have a family of six and we have been living in the same tent for the last three years. I work hard every day to provide food for my family. If I get sick my family will starve. So I cannot even afford to be sick.”

According to Chief Administrative Officer of Gangajamuna Rural Municipality Ram Chandra Itani, the local unit has provided the landslide-displaced families with some relief materials, such as two bundles of zinc sheets, groceries and tarpaulin, among others.

Rameshwar Simkhada, vice chairman of Gangajamuna Rural Municipality, said although there is no long-term solution to the problems faced by the landslide victims, the rural municipality is providing temporary relief under the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority.

“A committee has been formed to evaluate and develop schemes for the safety and well-being of the victims. We are working on finding long-term solutions,” he said.

Sarita Shrestha is the Dhading correspondent for Kantipur Publications.

title: Couple buried in landslide while collecting fodder in Arghakhanchi
article_text:
A couple lost their lives after being buried in a landslide while collecting fodder near their village in Arghakhanchi district on Monday.

According to police, 66-year-old Govinda Budhamagar and his 67-year-old wife Shyamakala Budhamagar of Dhanchaur Tallopakho of Bhumikasthan Municipality-10, were found dead at the scene.

The couple had left their home in the morning to cut grass and collect butternut fruit from their land at Tusarepani, said Police Constable Narbahadur Karki of the Dhanchaur Police Post.

Family members began searching when they failed to return by 1 pm. Their bodies were later discovered buried under debris from a dry landslide, likely triggered by loose soil conditions.

The deceased couple are survived by their daughter-in-law and grandson, who lived with them. They had three daughters—all married—and two sons, one of whom lives abroad and the other in Pokhara.

Birendra Kc is the Arghakhanchi correspondent for Kantipur Publications.

CHITWAN, Oct 7: Thousands of vehicles passing through Mugling were stranded due to massive landslides that took place on Wednesday at Abu Khaireni, which is located just a few kilometers from Mugling. Passengers spent hours at various road sections as vehicles plying the Mugling-Narayanghat and Mugling-Pokhara route were stuck due to the debris dumped on the highway by the landslides. Although the debris were cleared from various road sections by Thursday evening, vehicles have been able to pass only through one lane at various point along the highway, according to Yogendra Hamal, police inspector at the Mugling police check post. Before the landslides, passengers had been facing traffic snarls due to the upgradation of the stretch. The authorities responsible for upgrading the highway had claimed that it would not take more than two hours to cross Narayanghat-Mugling stretch as they had sealed the potholes along the road section keeping in mind the convenience of passengers during the festival. However, the experiences of thousands of passengers heading home to celebrate Dashain are different. There was a tailback stretching up to 18 km along Narayanghat-Mugling road section earlier in the day, while queue of vehicles was 9 km from Mugling to Kurin stretch, according to the Narayan-Mugling Road Project Office. A microbus (Lu 1 Ja 2037) en route to Bhairahawa, which left Kathmandu at 7 am reached Narayanghat only at 4 pm after being stuck in a traffic jam. One of the passengers, Sundar Bhusal, said he reached Mugling at 12 pm. It took them four hours to cross the 36 km road section. Likewise, another microbus (Ba 3 Kha 8593) en route to Dang had left Kathmandu at 8 am and reached Narayanghat only at 4 pm. “The debris left by Wednesday's landslides at Abu Khaireni, which caused severe bottleneck along the road section, was cleared only on Thursday. However, rains and other problems further exacerbated the traffic problems,” said Shiva Khanal, information officer of Narayanghat-Mugling Road Project. The road section is the main route connecting the country's eastern and western parts with the capital Kathmandu. It is the busiest road section in the country even at normal times. The normal traffic of 10,000 vehicles a day has increased significantly due to the rise in vehicular movements during the Dashain. Another reason for the traffic snarls on Thursday, according to Khanal, is due to 40 heavy trucks en route to Kathmandu transporting motorcycles for various showrooms. He added that at least six vehicles broke down en route, further contributing to the traffic snarls. The Narayanghat-Mugling stretch is being upgraded to two lanes as per Asian standard. However, the upgradation works is not going smoothly, creating hassles for passengers since a very long time ago.

title: Khumbu locals reopen trekking trail blocked by landslides - myRepublica - The New York Times Partner, Latest news of Nepal in English, Latest News Articles | Republica
article_text:
Subscribe Now

SOLUKHUMBU, July 20: Khumbu trekking route in Solukhumbu district that had remained obstructed for the past 10 days has now re-opened after locals cleared debris piled up as a result of landslides. Massive landslides triggered by incessant rainfall in Surke of Chaurikharka VDC-4 had blocked the route. Locals took it upon themselves after concerned authorities did nothing to reopen the route even 10 days after its closure. “Landslides in the route have severely affected movement of people and goods. Even cattle that are used as means for transporting goods could not travel,” said Bijaya Tamang, a local of Lukla. “The route is of utmost importance from tourism perspective. Its obstruction had made life miserable for people living in three upper VDCs. Hence, we jointly worked to reopen the route.” However, the debris on the route has not been completely cleared. Some of it has been removed, paving the way for mules and other cattle to travel despite some risks. “As this place has a difficult topography, it'll take some time to remove all the rubbles,” said Namgyal Sherpa, chairman of Chaurikharka-based Community Police Service Center. Since July 7, landslides have already buried five houses in Surke and posed serious risks to entire settlements. “Landslides are occurring from all sides,” said Indra Kumar Shrestha, another local. Those who have been left homeless by the landslides have been taking shelter in their neighbor's house. Others facing very high risks have headed to Lukla, which is about one hour walk from there, in search of safer shelter, according to locals. The local administration has said they plan to relocate risky settlements to safer locations at the earliest as landslides fear has not subsided. Chief District Officer (CDO) Krishna Prashad Sharma said they have sent some relief materials, including clothes, tarpaulins, and rice to landslide-hit Surkhe. As per data provided by the District Disaster Relief Committee (DDRC), a total of 12 VDCs throughout the district are at high risks of landslides. Among them, settlements of Baku VDC are considered to be the riskiest. Along with Baku, other VDCs including Deusa, Bung, Kaku, Bhanakje, Jubu, Necha Batase, Salyan, Tingla, Sotang, Mukli, and Gudel are also at high risks.

Resize Text Size Small Medium Large Listen By Republica DHORPATAN (BAGLUNG), Aug 11: Floods and landslides triggered by incessant rainfall have left 50 families displaced in Badigad of Baglung district.

As many as 50 households of Badigad Rural Municipality-9, Nayabasti, and Arupta, Patle, Clabjhing, Khor and Salle in ward 10 have been displaced due to recent landslides.

At least 11 people have been killed so far and the status of one is unknown. The displaced families are living a hapless life. There is no supply of drinking water and electricity in the landslide-hit areas. Children and the elderly are facing more problems.

Resize Text Size Small Medium Large Listen By Republica MYAGDI, July 25: Landslide prevention works have begun near the Baisari Andheri rivulet along the border of Raghu Ganga Rural Municipality-2 and 3 in Myagdi district after the Beni-Jomsom-Korala road section of the national pride project, Kaligandaki Corridor, started getting obstructed on a daily basis.

Workers have begun clearing the landslide debris on the road, and, to prevent further landslides, the 'rock anchoring' technology has been used on the Baisari road under the Beni-Jomsom road connecting Mustang with the national highway through the northern region of Myagdi.

Sub-engineer of the Beni-Jomsom-Korala Road Project, Sohan Jung Karki, said that the landslide prevention work has begun by drilling the hills above the road.

The Kaligandaki Corridor Project has been marred by landslides at more than 50 places along the Myagdi section, flooding from tributaries and erosion caused by the Kali Gandaki River. Residents of Raghuganga, Annapurna Rural Municipality of Myagdi, and Mustang, as well as tourists and pilgrims, have been facing difficulties in commuting as the Beni-Jomsom road has been obstructed due to landslides at Baisari and other places.

Resize Text Size Small Medium Large Listen By Republica DAMAULI, July 9: Lifeless body of a man who went missing in the landslide in Rishing rural municipality of Tanahun was recovered after 11 hours. Khum Bahadur Thapa, 40, of Rishing-8, Majhkot disappeared after being buried in the landslide debris at 5.00 am Thursday.

Chairperson of Nepal Red Cross Society, Kotdurbar Sub-branch, Indra Bahadur Ale confirmed that the dead body of Thapa was recovered 11 hours after his disappearance. Nepal Police and locals had intensified the search for the missing but it was tough due to the massive scale of the landslide.

Similarly, the status of Maita Bahadur Nepali of Myagde-4, who went missing in a rivulet has yet to be established, police said.

Floods leave 72 households displaced

Floods and landslides have rendered 72 households of Bandipur rural municipality displaced. At least 48 households of the same ward have been displaced.

The displaced households are of Bandipur-2, Khahare, Dharapani-3, ward-3, Ramkot and ward-5, Kalchowk. Floods have completely damaged 13 houses in Khahare and partially damaged nine houses while 26 houses are still at high risk, shared rural municipality vice-chair, Karuna Gurung.

Meanwhile, preparation is underway to place Hume pipe in the Chhabdii rivulet linking Byas municipality-1 and 13 to immediately ease the mobility. The municipality made the preparation to install Hume pipe after the flood that occurred on Wednesday washed away the bridge.

Resize Text Size Small Medium Large Listen Photo: Republica Photo: Republica By HIMNATH DEVKOTA Several more thought missing

RASUWA, July 27: Before they could fully recover from the devastation caused by the 2015 earthquakes, yet another disaster has befallen the locals of Timure in Rasuwa district. On Wednesday night, landslides triggered by incessant rainfalls claimed nine lives in Timure of Gosaikunda Rural Municipality-2, near the Nepal-China border.

It buried a police post, one temporary shelter and two hotels while people inside were asleep. Twelve more were rescued in the aftermath with the help of an excavator, informed Chief District Officer (CDO) Krishna Paudel of Rasuwa. They were taken to nearby Timure Health Post for treatment.

The deceased have been identified as Shyam Shrestha, Bikram Shrestha, Mangal Tamang and Sush Khadka of Bhotekoshi Rural Municipality-4, Sindhupalchowk district; Mingmar Gombo Tamang and Karsang Kimo Ghale of Gosainkunda Rural Municipality-1, Rasuwa; Dorjee Wangju Ghale of Gosainkunda-2; and Ramesh Tamang and Sharmila Kamini of Nuwakot.

“The deceased include a container driver, a hotel operator and hotel workers,” informed Police Inspector Dillip Chhetri.

Some more people are thought to be still buried under the landslide debris. Police said rescue operation is still ongoing. Two excavators and a dozer are being used for the rescue mission.

Landslides have also obstructed Rasuwagadhi trade route with the northern neighbor China. It could take up to two days to make the trade route functional, according to officials concerned. Consignment trucks headed for Kerung of China from Kathmandu and vice versa have been stranded following the landslides.

According to District Police Office, Rasuwa, landslides have blocked the route at several locations so it will take some time to reopen the road. Rasuwagadhi route is currently used extensively following the closure of Tatopani route after the 2015 earthquakes.

Resize Text Size Small Medium Large Listen By RSS GALESHWOR, August 23: Bagarphant village at Beni Municipality-2 in Myagdi district is grappling without drinking water for the past two months after landslides damaged water sources and pipelines.

On June 21, landslides at Maruwa, Upllo Khanna and Bankhe Chhaharo damaged water sources and pipelines causing acute shortage of water for 208 houses in the village. Shortly after the damaged water sources and pipelines were repaired, the water supply was resumed to the villagers.

Again, landslides at various places in the village damaged water sources and pipelines. Without clean and safe water, the local people are dependent on polluted water. "We are facing hard times without water supply. After 28 water taps in the village ran dry, we are forced to depend on polluted water from local wells," said Gopal Sharma, a local of Beni-2.

The water supply and sanitation project constructed a water project in the village in 2069 BS at the cost of Rs 5.4 million. Water was extracted from the local Kopre River at the border of Beni-3 and 2 and was distributed to the local people.

Earlier, flooding and landslides damaged water pipelines during every monsoon. "But we repaired them time and again. But this time, general repair is not enough and repair is not possible as well due to torrential rainfall," said the project chair Krishna Bahadur Karki, adding that repair work would take place after rainfall stops completely.

title: जनमत पार्टीमा स्पष्टीकरणको पहिरो | Nagarik News
article_text:
नागरिक अभिलेखालय

जनमत पार्टीका अध्यक्ष सिके राउतले उपाध्यक्ष दीपककुमार साह र कोषाध्यक्ष सुरेन्द्रनारायण यादवलाई शनिबार स्पष्टीकरण सोधेका छन्। स्पष्टीकरण नबुझाउँदासम्मका लागि उनीहरू निलम्बनमा परेका छन्। पार्टी केन्द्रीय समितिको आइतबार महोत्तरीको बर्दिबासमा सुरु भएको बैठकमा स्पष्टीकरण सोधिएका नेताहरू सहभागी भएका छैननन्।

अध्यक्ष राउतले यसअघि पार्टीका अर्का उपाध्यक्ष अब्दुल खान, वसन्तकुमार कुशवाह, सचिव बिपी साह, भोपेन्द्रप्रसाद यादव र अनिता देवी, केन्द्रीय सदस्य शम्भुनाथ साह, शिवचन्द्र कुशवाहलगायतलाई स्पष्टीकरण सोधेका थिए। अध्यक्ष राउतले केही नेतालाई पार्टीबाटै हटाइसकेका छन्। कैलाश महतो, रवीन्द्र यादवलगायत नेतालाई उनले पार्टीबाट हटाएका हुन्।

राउतले समानुपातिक सांसद गोमा लाभलाई पदबाट निलम्बन गर्न सभामुखलाई चिठी पठाएका छन्। तर सभामुखले उनलाई निलम्बन गरेका छैनन्। त्यसकारण सभामुखसँग राउत चिढिएका छन्। यसअघि राउतले लाभलाई पार्टीबाट कारबाही गरेको घोषणा गरेका थिए। राउतले यसअघि पार्टीबाट मधेस प्रदेशका मुख्यमन्त्री रहेका सतिश सिंहलाई समेत स्पष्टीकरण सोधेका थिए।

‘हाम्रो पार्टीमा स्पष्टीकरण सोध्नु र मन नपर्नेबित्तिकै निलम्बन गर्नु सामान्यझैं भइसकेको छ। यतिबेला धमाधम स्पष्टीकरण सोध्ने र निलम्बन गर्ने काम भइरहेको छ,’ स्पष्टीकरण सोधिएका कोषाध्यक्ष यादवले भने, ‘यसरी धमाधम स्पष्टीकरण सोध्दै जाने हो भने पार्टीलाई घाटा हुन्छ। घाटा भइरहेको छ पनि। यो कुरा स्पष्टीकरण सोध्नेले बुझ्नुपर्छ।’

उनले थपे, ‘कोषाध्यक्षको हैसियतबाट पार्टीमा पैसाको हिसाबकिताब माग्दा मलाई स्पष्टीकरण सोधिएको छ। अरू कारण केही छैन।’

स्पष्टीकरण सोधिएका केही नेताले पार्टी छाडिसकेका छन्। भोपेन्द्रप्रसाद यादव, शिवचन्द्र कुशवाहलगायत नेताले स्पष्टीकरण नबु्झाईकन पार्टी छाडेका हुन्। स्पष्टीकरण सोधेर उपाध्यक्षबाट निलम्बन गरिएका दीपक साहले भने, ‘यो पार्टी बनाउन मेरो पनि ठुलो योगदान छ। पार्टीमा मेरो पनि मोहियानी हक छ। त्यसैले कसैको सनकका भरमा पार्टी छाड्ने भन्ने प्रश्न हुँदैन। ममाथि झुटो आरोप लगाइएको छ।’

पार्टीका प्रवक्ता एवं अध्यक्ष राउतनिकट शरत्सिंह यादवले भने स्पष्टीकरण सोध्ने प्रक्रियाले पार्टीलाई घाटा नगरी उल्टै फाइदा गर्ने र संगठन बलियो हुने बताए। ‘स्पष्टीकरण सोध्ने व्यवस्था पार्टीको विधानमै गरिएको छ। स्पष्टीकरण सोधिएको व्यक्तिले सफाइ दिने मौका पाउँछ’, उनले भने, ‘स्पष्टीकरण मलाई पनि सोधिन सक्छ। त्यसैले यसलाई ठुलो विषय नबनाऔं।’ मधेस प्रदेशका मुख्यमन्त्रीलाई समेत स्पष्टीकरण सोध्ने काम भएको छ भन्दै उनले थपे, ‘हामीले मधेस प्रदेशका मुख्यमन्त्रीलाई समेत स्पष्टीकरण सोधेका छौं भने अरूलाई सोध्नु त्यति ठुलो विषय होइन।’

जनमत पार्टीका एक नेताका अनुसार पार्टीमा अध्यक्ष सिके राउतका दाजु जयकान्त राउत हाबी हुँदा पुराना नेताहरूमाथि धमाधम स्पष्टीकरण सोध्ने काम भइरहेको हो। पार्टी प्रवक्ता यादवका अनुसार बर्दिबासमा सुरु भएको केन्द्रीय समिति बैठक पार्टीको संगठन सुदृढीकरण तथा सबलीकरण, पार्टीले अघि सारेको नौलो गणतन्त्रको अजेन्डा कार्यान्वयन, संघीय लोकतान्त्रिक गणतन्त्रलाई संस्थागत गर्ने विषयमा केन्द्रित छ।

title: जोखिम नमानिएका क्षेत्रमा पहिरो खस्दा समस्या | Nagarik News
article_text:
नागरिक अभिलेखालय

चितवन - नारायणगढ–मुग्लिन सडक विस्तार गर्ने काम तीन वर्षदेखि चलिरहेको छ । पहाड फोरेर गरिएको सडक विस्तार अन्तिम चरणमा पुगे पनि वर्षात्को यो समयमा दैनिकजसो खस्ने पहिराका कारण बारम्बार सडक बन्द हुने गरेको छ ।

जसका कारण हुने घण्टौं जामले यो सडक भएर राजधानी भित्रिने तथा बाहिरिने हजारौं यात्रुले सास्ती भोग्नुपरिरहेको छ ।सडक विस्तारका लागि पहाड फोर्ने काम चलिरहँदा यसअघि यात्रु हिलाम्मे र खाल्डाखुल्डीयुक्त सडकमा यात्रा गर्न बाध्य थिए । अहिले पहिलो तहको कालोपत्रे (पीच) सकेर उक्त सडकखण्ड चिल्लो त पारिएको छ तर यो बर्खा मासमा दैनिकजसो खस्ने पहिरोका कारण यात्रुले भोग्नुपर्ने सास्ती भने कम हुन सकेको छैन ।नारायणगढ–मुग्लिन सडक खण्डमा पछिल्लो तीन दिनदेखि निरन्तर पहिरो खसिरहेको छ । पहिरो खस्दा पाँच घण्टादेखि ११ घण्टासम्म सडक अवरुद्ध हुने गरेको छ । बुधबार पनि चारकिलो भन्ने ठाउँमा पहिरो खस्दा पाँच घण्टा २० मिनेट सडक बन्द भयो । बिहान साढे ६ बजे खसेको पहिरो पन्छाएर ११ बजेर ५० मिनेट जाँदा मात्र यातायात सञ्चालन गरिएको थियो।

यसअघि मंगलबार चारकिलो नजिकैको टोपेखोलामा पहिरो जाँदा एघार घण्टा सडक बन्द भयो । बिहान ५ बजे खसेको पहिरो हटाउँदा दिउँसोको करिब ४ बजेको थियो । सोमबार जलविरे, कालिखोला, चारकिलो र तीन नम्बर पुल क्षेत्रमा पहिरो जाँदा करिब आठ घण्टा सडक अवरुद्ध भएको थियो।

ना २ ख ५११ नम्बरको माईक्रोबसका चालक हरि भुजेल मंगलबार काठमाडौंबाट नारायणगढ १२ घण्टामा आइपुगे । अहिले विस्तार गरिएको सडक राम्रो भए पनि पहिरोका कारण हुने सडक बन्द घण्टौं जामले धेरै समय लाग्ने गरेको उनले बताए । ‘पोहोर पहिरोले दुई रात नै यही सडकमा बस्नु परेको थियो,’ उनले भने, ‘वर्षाको यो दुई महिना गाडी चलाउन पहिरोले गर्दा धेरै गाह्रो हुन्छ ।’ बर्खाको समय अरू बेलाजस्तो छुट्याएर हिँडेको समयमा यात्रा पूरा नहुने उनले बताए ।

नारायणगढ–मुग्लिन सडक खण्डमा पछिल्लो तीन दिनदेखि निरन्तर पहिरो खसिरहेको छ । पहिरो खस्दा पाँच घण्टादेखि ११ घण्टासम्म सडक अवरुद्ध हुने गरेको छ ।

सडक खण्डमा आधाभन्दा बढी सडक पहाड फोरेर फराकिलो बनाइएको छ । यसै कारण सडकमा पहिरोको जोखिम बढेको हो । पानी परेका बेला मात्र होइन, अन्य बेलामा समेत सुक्खा पहिरो जाने जोखिम धेरै छ । जलविरेदेखि मुग्लिनसम्म पहिरोको उच्च जोखिम भएको क्षेत्र मानिन्छ । सडक आयोजनाका अनुसार गएको वर्ष सडकखण्डमा ३ सय १४ वटा ठूला पहिरो गएका थिए।

वर्षा सुरु भएसँगै यस वर्ष पनि पहिरो खसेर सडक बन्द हुने क्रम बढेको छ । यी तीन दिन पहिरो खसेका टोपे खोला, चारकिलो र जलविरे क्षेत्रलाई पहिरो खस्ने क्षेत्र मानिएको थिएन । नारायणगढ–मुग्लिन सडक आयोजनाका सिनियर डिभिजनल इन्जिनियर गोविन्दप्रसाद अर्याल जोखिम मानिएको क्षेत्रभन्दा फरक ठाउँमा पहिरो खसेको बताउँछन् । सडक विस्तार गर्न पहाड फोर्ने काम सकिएपछि गरिएको अध्ययनमा पाइएको जोखिमयुक्त ठाउँभन्दा फरक ठाउँमा पहिरो खसेको उनले जानकारी दिए ।

‘अनुमान गरिएभन्दा अन्य ठाउँबाट पहिरो झरिराखेको छ,’ उनले भने, ‘हामीले विज्ञहरूलाई देखाउँदा उनीहरूले दिएको रिपोर्टअनुसार पहिरो जोखिम क्षेत्र भनेर ३२ ठाउँ तोकेका थियौं ।’ विज्ञले औंल्याएका ३२ ठाउँमा भने पहिरो रोकथामका काम भइरहेका छन् । १४ करोड रुपैयाँको लागतमा रक एङकरिङ, रक नेटिङ, रक बोल्टिङ, बोस्टेरिङ, जुट नेटिङ र बायो इन्जिनियरिङका काम भइरहेका छन्।

असार मसान्तसम्म सक्ने गरी सुरु गरिएको पहिरो रोकथामका काम ६० प्रतिशत सकिएको सिनियर डिभिजनल इन्जिनियर अर्यालले जानकारी दिए । खुकुलो चट्टान भएका ठाउँमा सीधा र तेर्साे गरी दुईदेखि चार मिटर प्वाल पारेर रड राखिन्छन् । ती रडमा कंक्रिट हालेर रड र चट्टाटानलाई जमाउने कामलाई रक एङकरिङ भनिन्छ ।

रक एङकरिङ गरिएका ठाउँमा नट राखेर जालीले ढाक्ने रक नेटिङको काम सडक खण्डका नौ ठाउँमा भइरहेका छन् । एङ्करिङ जसरी नै मोटो रड राखेर चिरिएका ढुंगालाई झर्न नदिन गरिने उपाय नै रक बोल्टिङ भएको अर्यालले जानकारी दिए । कमजोर माटो भएको ठाउँलाई जुटले ढाकेर घाँस, विरुवाका बीउ छरेर पहिरो रोकथाम गर्ने काम पनि सडक खण्डमा भइरहेको छ।

भिरालो जमिनमा पानी बगेर पनि पहिरोको जोखिम बढ्ने भएकाले निश्चित ठाउँबाट पानी बग्ने गरी निकास बनाउन बोस्टेरिङको काम भइरहेको छ । यसका साथै घाँस, बिरुवा, बुट्यान लगाएर माटो बग्न नदिन बायो इन्जिनियरिङको काम पनि गरिँदैछ । पहिरो रोकथामका उपायहरू पहिले नै अनुमान गरिएका ठाउँमा मात्र गरिने सिनियर डिभिजनल इन्जिनियर अर्यालले जानकारी दिए ।

नयाँ देखिएका जोखिम ठाउँका लागि थप बजेट व्यवस्था भएपछि मात्र काम हुने उनले बताए । सडक विस्तार काम अहिलेसम्म ९३ प्रतिशत सकिएको सिनियर डिभिजनल इन्जिनियर अर्यालले जानकारी दिए । चौथोपटक थपिएको म्याद सकिएकाले निर्माण कम्पनीले फेरि म्याद थपको माग गरेर काम गरिरहेका छन् । सडक खण्डमा पहिरो नै खस्नबाट रोक्न नसकिए पनि पहिरो खस्नासाथ हटाउन सके मात्र पनि यात्रा धेरै सहज हुने थियो।

पहिरो खस्नासाथ हटाउन एक्साभेटर र लोडर ‘स्ट्यान्डबाई’ नहुँदा बाटो खुलाउन धेरै समय लाग्ने गरेको छ । नारायणगढ–मुग्लिन सडक भएर यात्रा गर्ने यात्रुलाई भइरहेको सास्तीलाई ख्याल गरेर सडकको सूचना एसएमएसबाट पनि लिन सकिने व्यवस्था गरिएको छ । जिल्ला ट्राफिक प्रहरी कार्यालय चितवनले सडक बन्द वा खुला के छ भन्ने बारेमा एसएमएसबाट जानकारी लिन सकिने सुविधा मंगलबारबाट दिन थालेको हो ।

पहिरो, दुर्घटना लगायतका कारण हुने सडक अवरुद्धको जानकारी एसएमएसबाट लिन सकिने ट्राफिक कार्यालयका प्रमुख वेदप्रसाद गौतमले जानकारी दिए । नारायणगढ–मुग्लिन सडकको अवस्थाबारे जानकारी लिन मोबाइलको म्यासेज बक्समा गएर एनएमटी टाइप गरी ३४८४८ मा एसएमएस गरेपछि आफ्नो मोबाइलमा जानकारी आउने जनाइएको छ ।

title: धादिङको आगिन्चोकमा पहिरो जाँदा एकै परिवारका तीन जनाको मृत्यु | Nagarik News
article_text:
नागरिक अभिलेखालय

धादिङको त्रिपुरासुन्दरी गाउँपालिका वडा नं ६ आगिञ्चोकमा पहिरो जाँदा एकै परिवारका तीन जनाको मृत्यु भएको छ। मृत्यु हुनेमा २५ वर्षीय मिलन खाँण, २२ वर्षीय श्रीमती सम्झना खाँण र दुइ वर्षीया छोरी अन्जिता खाँण रहेको जिल्ला प्रहरी कार्यालय धादिङका प्रहरी नायव उपरीक्षक रुपक खड्काले जानकारी दिए। अबिरल बर्षासँगै आएको पहिरोले पुरिदाँ मंगलबार बिहान मृत्यु भएको हो।

प्रहरी, उद्धारकर्मी र स्थानीयको सहयोगमा मृतकहरुको शव निकालिएको जिल्ला प्रहरी कार्यालय धादिङले जनाएको छ। सोमबार मात्रै गजुरी गाउँपालिकाकी १७ वर्षीया निरुता परिवारको पहिरोमा परि मृत्यु भएको थियो।

निरन्तरको बर्षाले जिल्लाको उत्तरी क्षेत्र र राजमार्ग क्षेत्रमा क्षति पु¥याएको छ। धादिङ र चितवन जोड्ने मौवाखोलाको पुल भत्किदाँ आवातजावत ठप्प छ। पृथ्वी राजमार्गको ठाउँठाउँमा पहिरो जाँदा सडक अवरुद्ध भएको छ।

title: जब पहिरो पन्छाउन सिडियो आफै पुगे... | Nagarik News
article_text:
नागरिक अभिलेखालय

म्याग्दीका प्रमुख जिल्ला अधिकारी ज्ञाननाथ ढकाल शुक्रबार विहानै अवरुद्ध बेनी– बागलुङ सडकखण्डको मर्मतमा निस्किए। बेनी नगरपालिका–१ रत्नेचौरका विभिन्न बस्तीमा नदी र पहिरोले सडक अवरुद्ध भएपछि प्रजिअ ढकालले आनन्दबगर, लामगरा, सिम र सारेमारेमा बाढीपहिरोको असरले अवरुद्ध भएको सडक र जोखिमको अवलोकन सँगै तत्काल स्थानीय सरकारसँग समन्वय गरे। लगत्तै धार्मिकस्थल गलेश्वरमा कालिगण्डकी नदीको कटानको अवलोकन गर्न पुगे, त्यसको केही समयमा लायन्स क्लवको राहत साम्रागी हस्तान्तरण गरेपछि खाना नखाई पुनः भत्किएको बेलिब्रिजको मर्मतस्थलमा पुगे।

दैनिकजसो प्रशासनीक काममा ब्यस्त हुनुपर्ने प्रजिअ ढकाल असार महिना यता प्रशासनीकसँगै विपद्ले तहसनहस बनाएको जिल्लाका विभिन्न स्थानमा पुगेर दिनभरी श्रमदान समेत गरेका छन्। अविरल बर्षाले चारदिनदेखि अवरुद्ध पश्चिम म्याग्दी जोड्ने बेनी–दरबाङ सडकखण्डको घुमाउने तालमा दिनभरी मजदुरसँगै श्रमदान समेत गरे। एकाविहानैदेखि मध्यरातसम्म विपत् व्यवस्थापनको क्षेत्रमा तत्काल खोज, उद्धार र व्यवस्थापनमा प्रजिअ ढकालको भूमिकाबाट जिल्लाबासी सन्तुष्ट छन्। २०७६ साल साउन १५ गते जिल्लामा आएका प्रजिअ ढकालको सिडियो जिल्लाको प्रशासनीक प्रमुखसँगै जनताको सेवक पनि भएको स्थलगत रुपमै महसुस हुने गरी काम गरेका छन्।

‘कार्यालयको कुर्चीमा बसेर सेवा प्रवाह मात्रै मेरो जिम्मेबारी होईन्,‘अवरुद्ध बाटो पन्छाउन आवश्यक परेको ठाउँमा जनश्रमदानमै जान्छु’ प्रजिअ ढकालले भने। बाढीपहिरोको उच्च जोखिममा रहेको म्याग्दीमा कार्यालयभित्रको प्रशासनीक कामसँगै फिल्डमा पुगेर स्थानीय सररकारसँग समन्वय गरिरहेको बताए। ‘मर्मतमा अटेर गर्ने निर्माण ब्यवसायीलाई चेतावनी पनि दिनुपर्ने रहेछ,‘फोनबाट मात्रै भनेर समान्य मर्मत पनि महिनौं लगाउने चलन रहेछ’ प्रजिअ ढकालले भने।

पश्चिम क्षेत्रमा पर्ने धवलागिरी र मालिका गाउँपालिकामा बाढीपहिरोले २८ जनाले ज्यान गुमेको र बस्ती नै विस्थापित भएको अवस्थामा खाद्यान्न लगायतका साम्रागी ढुवानी गर्ने सडक नै अवरुद्ध भएपछि पटक–पटक अवलोकन र सम्बन्धित कार्यालयका प्रमुख र ठेकेदारलाई समेत कडा चेतावनी दिएपछि मात्रै कामले तिब्रता पाएको प्रजिअ ढकालको भनाई छ। हरेक बिहान ४ बजे उठिसक्ने र राती करिब ११ बजेसम्म फिल्डमै विताउँदा जनताको मायाँ धेरै पाएको प्रजिअ ढकालको भनाई छ। उनले जिल्लाभर बाढीपहिरोले तहसनहस बनाइरहेको अवस्थामा कार्यालयको काम बाहेक फिल्डमै खटिने गरेको बताए। उत्तरी म्याग्दी हुँदै मुस्ताङ जोड्ने बेनी–जोमसोम सडकखण्डको गलेश्वरमा रहेको बेलिब्रिजलाई तीनदिनभित्र सञ्चालनमा ल्याउन सक्रिय रहेको बताए।

‘विपद्मा गैँची समातेर हिड्छु, ढुंगा फाल्छु,‘मजदुरकै भूमिका पनि निभाउनुपर्ने अवस्था आउँछ’ प्रजिअ ढकालले भने। विपद्मा जिल्लामा दैनिक हस्तान्तरण हुने राहत साम्रागी बुझ्ने, स्थलगत अनुगमन गर्ने, जिल्लाभित्रका जनताका अनेक समस्या समाधानमा तल्लिन प्रजिअ ढकालसँग जिल्लाका सरोकारवाला निकाय समेत पुर्णरुपमा सन्तुष्ट छन्। ‘प्रजिअ ढकाल नै आएर बाटोमा बसेपछि अवरुद्ध सडक पन्छाउन सजिलो भयो,‘उहाँले मजदुरकै रुपमा काम गर्नुभयो’ बेनी नगरपालिका–४ तातोपानीका यूवा कुमार केसीले भने। मजदुरसँगै खटिएका प्रजिअले सडक सुचारु गरेपछि मात्रै फर्किएको बताए।

अवरुद्ध सडकको मर्मतमा स्थानीय जनप्रतिनिधि भन्दा अगाडी नै पुग्ने प्रजिअ ढकाललाई सुरक्षा निकायको उस्तै साथले थप सहज भएको छ। पोशाकमा सडक मर्मतमा खटिएका नेपाल प्रहरी, नेपाली सेना र सशस्त्र प्रहरीको टोलीलाई जनप्रतिनिधि र स्थानीयको समेत साथ रहेको छ। चुस्त, दुरुस्त र सुशासनयुक्त प्रशासनका लागि कार्य सम्पादन मूल्यांकनमा जोड दिएका प्रजिअले कोरोना भाइरस बिरुद्धको अभियानमा समेत उस्तै सक्रियता देखाएका थिए। शारीरिक रूपमा ‘हेभिवेट’ ढकालको जनसेवामा देखाएको सक्रियताले उनको कार्यशैली र मेहनतको उच्च प्रशंसा हुने गरेको छ। प्रजिअ ढकालले जिल्लाबाट निर्वाचित जनप्रतिनिधि, राजनीतिक दलका नेता, नागरिक समाज लगायतसँग समेत आवश्यकता अनुसार समन्वय गर्ने गरेका छन्।

title: कर्णाली राजमार्गमा पहिरो, यातायात अवरुद्ध | Nagarik News

अविरल वर्षाले पहिरो खस्दा कर्णाली राजमार्गमा यातायात सञ्चालन रोकिएको छ। सुर्खेत–जुम्ला सडकअन्तर्गत कालीकोटको खाँडाचक्र नगरपालिका–२ कालेखोलामा सडक भत्किँदा सवारी आवागमन अवरुद्ध भएको हो।

पहिरो खस्दा राजमार्ग अवरुद्ध भएको जिल्ला प्रहरी कार्यालय कालीकोटले जनाएको छ।

अहिले पहिरो पन्छाउने काम भइरहेको छ। वर्षाले कर्णाली राजमार्गअन्तर्गत कालीकोट खण्डको दहीखोला, गगनेखोला, एसमोड र हुल्ममा बारम्बार पहिरो जाने गरेको छ।

title: पर्वतको लाङ्दी पहिरो : दम्पतीको शव भेटियो | Nagarik News
article_text:
नागरिक अभिलेखालय

मोदी गाउँपालिका–३ देउरालीको लाङ्दी पहिरोमा पुरिएका दम्पतीको शव भेटिएको छ। छविलाल विश्वकर्मा र उनकी ७६ वर्षीया श्रीमती विष्णुमतिको शव भेटिएको जिल्ला प्रहरी कार्यालयले जनाएको छ। गए रातिको पहिरोमा विक दम्पती परेका हुन्।

गए रातिदेखि पर्वतलगायत आसपासका क्षेत्रमा निरन्तर वर्षा भइरहेको छ। यस क्षेत्रका मोदी, पाती, सेती, मल्याङ्दी, लमाए खोला र कालीगण्डकी जलसतह बढेको छ। स्थानीय प्रशासनले नदी तथा खोला किनारका बासिन्दालाई सचेत रहन आग्रह गरेको छ। रासस यो पनि पढ्नुहोस् पर्वतको लाङ्दी पहिरो : श्रीमान् मृत फेला, श्रीमतीको खोजी जारी

यो पनि पढ्नुहोस् पर्वतको लाङ्दीमा पहिरोले घर पुरिँदा दम्पती बेपत्ता

title: वर्षाका कारण पहिरो खस्दा विभिन्न राजमार्ग अवरुद्ध | Nagarik News
article_text:
नागरिक अभिलेखालय

केही दिनयताको वर्षाका करण पहिरो खस्दा देशका विभिन्न क्षेत्रका मुख्य राजमार्ग अवरुद्ध भएका छन्।

सोमबार राति इलाम रोङ गाउँपालिका–६ सलकपुर स्थित भित्री कच्ची सडकखण्ड, काभ्रे नमोबुद्ध नगरपालिका–६ चौकीडाँडा र रोशी गाउँपालिका–७ घुमाउने, चारसयबेँसीस्थित बिपी राजमार्ग सडक पूर्ण रूपमा अवरुद्ध भएको केन्द्रीय प्रहरी प्रवक्ता एवं प्रहरी नायब महानिरीक्षक अविनारायण काफ्लेले जानकारी दिए।

उनले भने, 'यही वैशाख १२ गतेको बाढीले अवरुद्ध भएको भोजपुर नगरपालिका–५ बोखिमको मध्यपहाडी लोकमार्ग, १६ गतेको पहिराले अवरुद्ध म्याग्दीको अन्नपूर्ण गाउँपालिका–३ जलथलेस्थित बेनी–जोमसोम सडकखण्ड तथा लमजुङ मध्यनेपाल नगरपालिका–१० बिमिरेभन्ज्याङस्थत मध्यपहाडी लोकमार्ग भने एकतर्फी रूपमा सञ्चालन भएका छन्।'

वर्षातको समयमा बाढीपहिरोको जोखिम बढी हुने भएकाले अवरुद्ध भएका र एकतर्फी सञ्चालन भएका राजमार्गमा यात्रा गर्दा सुरक्षित एवं सावधानी तरिकाले यात्रा गर्न प्रहरीले आग्रह गरेको छ।

title: Landslides in Taplejung - Nepali Times
article_text:
Landslides in Taplejung district’s Phungling area claimed the lives of four and destroyed many houses

Landslides in Taplejung district’s Phungling area claimed the lives of four and destroyed many houses after heavy rains in the region last night.

Three bodies were recovered by the joint efforts of the Nepali Police, Armed Police Force and Nepal Army this morning. Identified as the wife, daughter and son of Tika Magar, the three succumbed to death after their house was buried under a landslide while they were asleep.

In another incident, Maili Subba from Phungling-8 was also buried under a landslide after she tried to escape from her house, while Kanchhi Subba was injured.

Triggered by torrential rains, the landslides started at 1 am and have affected many areas and damaged homes in the district. Traffic in the Mechi Highway has also been obstructed as a result.

The houses of local residents Bhuwanishankar Nepal, Agniprasad Bhandari, Teknath Dahal, Dilliram Adhikari, Rajkumar Magar, Guruprasad Biswakarma, Som Bahadur Bik and Gangamaya Bhattarai were swept away.

In Phungling-2 , seven houses -- including that belonging to Kenima Netraprasad Bhattarai -- were damaged by the landslide. Similarly, ten houses close to municipality-9 were also destroyed.

Following the incident, local residents have been evacuated to a safer location. However, the rain and the landslides still continue.

Laxmi Gautam

title: पहिरोले अवरुद्ध बुटवल- पाल्पा सडक एकतर्फी खुल्याे – Nepal Press
article_text:
रुपन्देही । आइतबार विहानदेखि अवरुद्ध बुटवल पाल्पा सडक एकतर्फी खुलेको छ । पाल्पाको तानसेन नगरपालिका- ८ डुम्रेमा खसेको केही पहिरो पन्छाएपछि सडक एकतर्फी खुलेको जिल्ला प्रहरी कार्यालय पाल्पाका डिएसपी रामेश्वर त्वातीले जानकारी दिएका छन् ।

अविरल वर्षासँगै राजमार्गका एकदर्जन जति ठाउँमा पहिरो जाँदा आइतबार विहानबाट सडक अवरुद्ध भएको थियो ।

अन्य ठाउँका पहिरो आइतबार नै पन्छाएपनि डुम्रेमा ठूलो पहिरो खसेकाले सडक सुचारु गर्न समय लागेको थियो । सोमबार दिउसोसम्म विभिन्न ठाउँमा साना साना पहिरो खसेकाले समय लागेको प्रहरीले जनाएको छ ।

title: पहिरोले डुम्रे-बेँसीसहर सडक अवरुद्ध – Nepal Press
article_text:
लमजुङ । अविरल वर्षासँगै आएको बाढी पहिरोले गए रातिदेखि डुम्रे –बेँसीसहर सडक अवरुद्ध भएको छ ।

सो सडकअन्तर्गत बेँसीसहर नगरपालिका–१ उदिपुरको देउराली डाँडा पहिराले सडक अवरुद्ध बनाएको जिल्ला प्रहरी कार्यालयका प्रहरी निरीक्षक जगदीश रेग्मीले जानकारी दिए ।

वैकल्पिक सडकको रुपमा रहेको श्रीजङ्ग गण नेपाली सेनाको ब्यारेक, रिठ्ठेबगर हुँदै उदिपुर बजार जोडिने यस सडक माथिबाट रिठ्ठेबगरमा लेदो आएर सडक अवरुद्ध बनेको उनको भनाइ छ । लेदोले सडक अवरुद्ध हुनुका साथै उक्त स्थानको वैकल्पिक सडक पनि भासिएको छ । मस्र्याङ्दी नदीले तलबाट कटान गर्नुका साथै माथिबाट बगेर आएको लेदोले करिब तीन मिटर सडक भासिएको प्रहरीले जनाएको छ ।

सडक अवरुद्धका कारण बिहानैबाट कुनै पनि सवारी साधन आवतजावत हुन सकेको छैन । डुम्रे बेँसीसहर सडक खण्डअन्तर्गत उक्त देउराली डाँडामा गत वर्ष समेत पहिरो गएपछि वैकल्पिकरुपमा सो स्थान नजिकै माथिबाट सडक सञ्चालन गरे पनि गत पहिरो हप्तामा आएको बाढी पहिरोले उक्त सडकसमेत बगाएपछि उक्त सेनाको सडक हुँदै सवारी सञ्चालन हुन थालेको छ ।

सडक अवरुद्ध भएपछि बेँसीसहरबाट काठमाडौँ, पोखरा, चितवन, गोरखा, तनहुँलगायत जाने सो स्थानबाट बेँसीसहर आउने सवारी साधन सञ्चालन हुन सकेको छैन । यसअघि समेत गत असार २८ गते सोही स्थानमा सडक अवरुद्ध भएको थियो भने, सो अघि पटकपटक सडक अवरुद्ध हुँदै आएको थियो । ४२ किलोमिटर दूरी रहेको यस सडकमा पहिराले यात्रुलाई समस्या उत्पन्न गराउँदै आएको छ ।

title: कोशी प्रदेशमा बाढी र पहिरोको वितण्डा : ३१ जना बेपत्ता, सडक सञ्जाल टुट्यो – Nepal Press
article_text:
विराटनगर । बाढीका कारण कोशी प्रदेशमा ३१ जना बेपत्ता भएका छन् । गए राति आएको बाढी र पहिरोमा सङ्खुवासभामा २२ जना ताप्लेजुङ्मा ४ जना र पाँचथारमा ५ जना बेपत्ता भएको सशस्त्र प्रहरी बल कोशी प्रदेश प्रमुख अन्जनी पोखरेलले बताए ।

सङ्खुवासभाको हेवाखेलामा गए राति आएको बाढीले सात घर बगाएको छ । अविरल वर्षासँगै आएको बाढीले हेवाखोला किनारका सात घर बगाएको जिल्ला प्रहरी कार्यालयले जनाएको छ ।

अप्पर हेवाखोला हाइड्रोपावरमा काम गर्ने एक मजदुरको शव पाँचखपन नगरपालिका–५ खोला किनारमा फेला परेको प्रहरीले जनाएको छ । प्रहरी प्रमुख गोदारका अनुसार शवको पहिचान हुन बाँकी छ ।

बाढीले पाँचखपन र चैनपुर जोड्ने निर्माणाधीन मोटरेबल पुलमा क्षति पुर्‍याएको छ ।

गए रातिदेखि परेको अविरल वर्षासँगै आएको बाढीले बगाउँदा पाँचथरमा पाँच जना बेपत्ता भएका छन् ।

बेपत्ता हुनेमा हेवा–१ जलविद्युत् आयोजनामा कार्यरत हिलिहाङ–७ का दिलकुमार तामाङ र फिदिम–१० का सन्जोग लोवा, फिदिम–४ माझीटारमा बोत्तल हाउस सञ्चालन गरेर बसेका आशिष र एलिसा माझी र फिदिम–४ हेवाखोलाबाट एक जना रहेका छन् ।

title: बाढी र पहिरो क्षेत्रमा पुगे सुरक्षा निकायका प्रमुखसहित मन्त्री मेन्यांवो – Nepal Press
article_text:
विराटनगर । कोशी प्रदेशका पहाडी जिल्लामा शनिबार राति आएको बाढी र पहिरोको स्थलगत निरीक्षणका लागि खानेपानी सिँचाइ तथा स्वास्थ्य मन्त्री तिलकुमार मेन्यांवो सहितको टोल घटना स्थलतर्फ गएको छ ।

ताप्लेजुङ पाँचथर र संखुवासभामा बाढी र पहिरोले पुर्याएको क्षति र प्रभाव मूल्याङ्कनका लागि गएको टोलीमा तीनवटै सुरक्षा निकायका प्रदेशस्थित प्रमुखहरू समेत सहभागी छन् ।

बाढी र पहिरोले पुर्याएको क्षति र राहतको लागि प्रभाव मूल्याङ्कन गर्न घटनास्थल तर्फ गएको टोलीमा प्रदेश सभा सदस्य विदुर लिङ्थेप समेत छन् ।

टोलीमा नेपाली सेनाका पृतनापति र नेपाल प्रहरीका डिआइजी राजेशनाथ बास्तोला, सशस्त्र प्रहरी बलका बलका डी आइ जी अन्जनी कुमार पोख्रेलसमेत सहभागी छन् । घटनास्थलमा पुगेपछि राहतका लागि सरकारले निर्णय गरिने मन्त्री मेन्यांवोले बताए ।

title: पहिरोले संखुवासभामा ३ घर बगायो, एकजना घाइते – Nepal Press
article_text:
संखुवासभा । संखुवासभाको खाँदबारी नगरपालिका-११ आङ्लास्थित कोक्तिमा गाउँमा पहिरोले तीन घर बगाएको छ । गएराति अबिरल वर्षासँगै गएको पहिरोले कोक्तिमा गाउँका तीन घर बगाएको छ भने एकजना घाइते भएका छन् ।

मणिप्रसाद राई, रामप्रसाद राई र दीलबहादुर राईको घर पहिरोले बगाएको जिल्ला प्रहरी कार्यालयका निमित्त प्रहरी प्रमुख प्रहरी निरीक्षक रामकुमार लामिछानेले जानकारी दिए । पहिरोमा परेर मणिप्रसाद राई घाइते भएका छन् ।

पहिरोले घर बगाएर विस्थापित भएपछि उनीहरू छिमेकीको घरमा आश्रय लिएर बसिरहेका छन् । पहिरोबाट जिल्लाका विभिन्न ठाउँमा ९ घर विस्थापित भएको लामिछानेले बताए ।

खाँदबारी-४ सेकाहाका चार घर पहिरोबाट विस्थापित भएका वडा नम्बर ४ का वडाध्यक्ष विनोद सुब्बा गुरुङले जानकारी दिए । चिचिला गाउँपालिकाको १ र २ का पाँच घर पहिरोको उच्च जोखिममा परेको प्रहरीले जनाएको छ । जिल्लामा बाढी पहिरोले के-कति क्षति भयो भन्ने विवरण संकलन भइरहेको प्रहरी निरीक्षक लामिछानेले बताए ।

पहिरोले उत्तर–दक्षिण कोशी सडकमा समेत क्षति पुगेको छ । कालोपत्र गर्न ठिक्क पारिएको चार किलोमिटर सडकमा क्षति पुगेको उत्तरदक्षिण कोशी सडक आयोजनाले जनाएको छ । यो कोशी राजमार्गअन्तर्गत खाँदबारी किमाथाङ्का सडकखण्डमा पर्दछ ।

निरन्तरको वर्षाका कारण मकालु गाउँपालिकाको नुममा पहिरो गएपछि सडक अवरुद्ध भएको छ । पहिरोका कारण करिब रु एक करोडको क्षति भएको सडक कार्यालयले जनाएको छ ।

title: कास्कीमा पहिरोमा परेर २ बालबालिकाको मृत्यु – Nepal Press
article_text:
पोखरा । अविरल वर्षापछि पहिरोमा परेर कास्कीमा दुई छुट्टाछुट्टै घटनामा एक बालक र एक बालिकाको मृत्यु भएको छ । उक्त घटनामा एकजना घाइते भएका छन् ।

कास्कीको मादी गाउँपालिका–५ चितेपानी घुम्तीमा गए राति पहिरोमा पुरिएर १३ वर्षीया आयुस्मा रानाभाटको मृत्यु भएको जिल्ला प्रहरी कार्यालय कास्कीका प्रवक्ता एवं प्रहरी नायब उपरीक्षक वसन्तकुमार शर्माले जानकारी दिए ।

पहिरो परि घाइते ७० वर्षीया हजुरआमा लालमाया बन्जाराको उद्धार गरिएको छ । घटना घटेका बेला घरमा नातिनी र हजुरआमा मात्र रहेका थिए । इलाका प्रहरी कार्यालय शिशुवाको टोलीले लालमायाको उद्धार गरेको हो ।

यसैगरी गए राति नै पोखरा महानगरपालिका–२७ आरुपाटामा ३१ वर्षीय हरि सुनारको दुई कोठाको कच्ची घर पहिरोले भत्किँदा उनका तीन वर्षीय छोरा अनमोलको मृत्यु भएको छ ।

उक्त घटनामा सुनारकी श्रीमती २७ वर्षीया रितु घाइते भएकी प्रहरी नायब उपरीक्षक शर्माले बताए । उनको गण्डकी मेडिकल कलेजमा उपचार भइरहेको छ । सो घटनामा हरि र उनका नौ वर्षीया छोरी अञ्जलीको सकुशल उद्धार गरिएको छ । पोखरामा गए रातिदेखि निरन्तर वर्षा भइरहेको छ ।

title: पहिरोले घर पुरिँदा स्याङ्जामा आमा छोरीको मृत्यु – Nepal Press
article_text:
पोखरा । पहिरोले घर पुरिँदा स्याङ्जामा आमा छोरीको मृत्यु भएको छ ।

गएराती घरमाथिबाट खसेको पहिरोमा परेर फेदीखोला गाउँपालिका–५ बाँगेकी ३१ वर्षीय दुर्गा जिटी र ३ वर्षीय छोरी निकिसा जिटीको मृत्यु भएको जिल्ला प्रहरी कार्यालय स्याङजाले जनाएको छ ।

पहिरोले घरसँगै गोठ पनि पूर्ण रुपमा क्षति डिएसपी इन्द्रबहादुर रानाले जानकारी दिए ।

title: बडिगाड पहिरो : तीन बालबालिका अझै बेपत्ता – Nepal Press
article_text:
बलेवा । बडिगाड गाउँपालिका-१० आरुपाटामा मङ्गलवार बिहान खसेको पहिरोमा परेका तीनजना बालबालिकाको अवस्था अझै अज्ञात छ ।

पहिरोमा परेका सात वर्षकी मधु र १० वर्षका मनोज बुढा तथा ११ वर्षका सुमन थापाको नेपाली सेना, सशस्त्र प्रहरी बल नेपाल र नेपाल प्रहरीको संयुक्त टोलीले खोजी गरिरहेको छ ।

पहिरोमा ज्यान गुमाएका ७८ वर्षीय जोगबहादुर बुढा, १४ वर्षीय यमलाल विक, ११ वर्षीया सीता पुन, आठ वर्षीया अमलबुढा, सञ्जु विककी छ महिनाकी छोरी सीता र ७० वर्षीया मैतीदेवी विकको शव फेला परे पनि अन्यको अवस्था अज्ञात रहेको बडिगाड गाउँपालिकाकी अध्यक्ष गण्डकी थापाले बताइन् ।

अध्यक्ष अधिकारीका अनुसार गम्भीर घाइते भएका १० जनामध्ये १९ वर्षीया रिमा पुन, ३१ वर्षीया सीता थापा र ४६ वर्षीया सङ्गीता बुढाको काठमाडौँस्थित त्रिभुवन विश्वविद्यालय शिक्षण अस्पतालमा उपचार भइरहेको छ ।

झब्रिखेत बस्ती जोखिममा

यसैबीच, सडक निर्माणसँगै झब्रिखेतमा पहिरो खस्न थालेको छ । त्यहाँ निरन्तर पहिरो खसेपछि जैमिनी नगरपालिका–१ कुश्मीशेराको बस्ती जोखिममा परेको छ ।

कुश्मीशेरा बजारबाट प्राथमिक स्वास्थ्य केन्द्र कुश्मीशेरा हुँदै बलेवा अमलाचौर जोड्ने सडक विस्तार भएको स्थानमा पहिरो खस्न सुरु भएको हो ।

हरेक वर्षको पहिराले प्रभावित भएका यहाँका केही बासिन्दा विस्थापित भएका पहिरोपीडित दीपक पौडेलले बताउनुभयो ।

पहिरोका कारण पौडेल परिवार विस्थापित भइसकेको छ, भने स्थानीय रेशमलाल आचार्य, राजेन्द्र आचार्यलगायत स्थानीयका घर जोखिममा छन् ।

title: सिस्नेरी पहिरो अपडेट : एन्फा एकेडेमीका तीनजना विद्यार्थीको शव फेला – Nepal Press
article_text:
हेटौँडा । मकवानपुरको सिस्नेरीमा पहिरोमा परि हराइरहेका एन्फा एकेडेमीका ६ जना विद्यार्थी मध्ये तीन जनाको शव फेला परेको छ ।

मकवानपुर सिस्नेरीमा रहेको अखिल नेपाल फुटबल संघ (एन्फा) एकेडेमीका ६ विद्यार्थी विद्यार्थी पहिरोमा पुरिएका थिए ।

हराइरहेका ६ मध्य तीन जनाको शव फेला परेको इन्द्रसरोबर गाउँपालिका अध्यक्ष डिके पुडासैनीले नेपालप्रेसलाई बताए ।

बिहीबार देखि अविरल वर्षाका कारण कुलेखानीको ड्याम खोलेपछि सुरक्षित स्थानतर्फ जाने क्रममा पहिरोमा परेका थिए ।

कुलेखानी ड्यामको ढोका खुलेपछि ती विद्यार्थीले छोटो बाटो प्रयोग गरी हिँडेपछ ि पहिरोमा परेको बताइएको छ ।

बेपत्ता विद्यार्थीहरूमा अनुप घलान मकवानपु, आदित्य वलम्पाकी सर्लाही, रियान्स आचार्य, काठमाडौं, सुमन योन्जन मकवानपुर, विकल रेग्मी, निजगढ, दिवस बानियाँ मकवानपुर रहेका छन् ।

उनीहरुमध्ये शव भेटिएकाहरुको पहिचान भइनसकेको अध्यक्ष पुडासैनीको भनाई छ ।

एन्फा केन्द्रीय सदस्य टीकाराम लामा अनुसार स्थानीय वत्सला माविमा होस्टलसहित आवासीय व्यवस्था गरी दैनिक प्रशिक्षणमा राखिएका ४० जना खेलाडीमध्ये ६ जना सम्पर्कविहीन भएका हुन् ।

title: अपडेटः बाढी, पहिरोमा मृत्यु हुनेको संख्या १०४ पुग्यो – Nepal Press
article_text:
काठमाडौं । बाढी, पहिरोमा परी मृत्यु हुनेको संख्या १०४ पुगेको छ ।

नेपाल प्रहरीका अनुसार अहिलेसम्म ६४ जनाको अवस्था अज्ञात छ । यस्तै ७३ जना घाइते छन् ।

प्रहरीले ३०३९ भन्दा बढीको उद्धार गरिएको जनाएको छ । प्रहरीले लामो यात्रामा निस्किनुभन्दा पहिले जानकारी लिएर मात्रै जान आग्रह समेत गरेको छ ।

title: कालिकोटमा पहिरामा पुरिएर महिलाको मृत्यु : RajdhaniDaily.com
article_text:
मान्म । नरहरिनाथ गाउँपालिका–७ माल्कोटको दुदुल्लीमा पहिरो जाँदा एक महिलाको मृत्यु भएको छ । माल्कोटको भैँसी चराउने लेक दुदुल्लीमा शनिबार पहिरो जाँदा स्थानीयवासी ३५ वर्षीया तुला बटालाको ज्यान गएको हो ।

भैँसी गोठाला जानुभएका बटालाको पहिरामा पुरिएर मृत्यु भएको प्रहरी नायब उपरीक्षक श्यामबाबु ओलियाले बताए । ‘भैँसी गोठबाट पानी लिन जाँदा बीच बाटामा पहिरो खसेर महिलालाई बगाएको हो’, उहाँले भने, ‘उहाँको घटनास्थलमै मृत्यु भयो । प्रहरीचौकी कुमालगाउँबाट घटनास्थलमा प्रहरीको टोली पठाएर बटालाको शव परीक्षणका लागि जिल्ला अस्पताल ल्याइएको छ ।’

यस्तै शनिबार आएको पहिराले नरहरिनाथ गाउँपालिका–७ को वडा कार्यालयमा पनि क्षति पुगेको छ । प्रनाउ ओलियाका अनुसार माल्कोटमा रहेको छकोठे वडा कार्यालयको भवन पहिराबाट पुरिएको छ । भाडामा रहेको वडा कार्यालयका साथ वडा कार्यालयमा भएका जिन्सी सामान पनि पुरिएको जनाइएको छ ।

title: मकवानपुरका स्थानीय तहलाई सशस्त्रको विपद् व्यवस्थापन तालिम : RajdhaniDaily.com
article_text:
हेटौडा । आन्तरिक मामिला तथा कानुन मन्त्रालय, बागमती प्रदेश सरकार तथा जिल्ला विपद् व्यवस्थापन समिति मकवानपुरको संयोजन तथा सशस्त्र प्रहरी बल, नेपाल नं. १४ गण हे.क्वा. मकवानपुरको सहजीकरणमा स्थानीय तहहरुको लागि ‘विपद् व्यवस्थापन अभिमुखीकरण तालिम’ आइतबार मनहरी गाउँपालिकाको कार्यालय मनहरीमा समुद्घाटन भएको छ ।

सो तालिमको उद्घाटन समारोहमा बागमती प्रदेश सरकारका आन्तरिक मामिला तथा कानुन मन्त्री कृष्णप्रसाद शर्मा खनाल, मनहरी गाउँपालिकाका अध्यक्ष रन्जन कालाखेती, आन्तरिक मामिला तथा कानुन मन्त्रालयका सचिव नारायणप्रसाद शर्मा, मनकवानपुर जिल्लाका निमित्त प्रमुख जिल्ला अधिकारी बद्रीनाथ गैह्रे, मनहरी गाउँपालिकाकी उपाध्यक्ष सिता पुलामी मगर, सशस्त्र प्रहरी बल, नेपाल नं. १४ गण हे.क्वा. मकावानपुरका गणपति सशस्त्र प्रहरी उपरीक्षक नेत्रबहादुर कार्की, जिल्लास्थित सुरक्षा निकायका प्रमुखहरु, गाउँपालिका वडा अध्यक्षहरु, नेपाल स्काउट, सञ्चारकर्मी तथा स्थानिय बासिन्दाको उपस्थिति रहेको थियो ।

विपद् व्यवस्थापन सम्बन्धी ज्ञान र सिपयुक्त स्वयम सेवकहरु उत्पादन गरी विपद्बाट हुन सक्ने क्षतिलाई न्यूनीकरण गर्न र स्थानीय आपतकालीन कार्य सञ्चालन केन्द्रहरुलाई थप सक्रिय बनाउने उद्देश्यले संचालित उक्त तालिममा मनहरी गाउँपालिककाा प्रेत्यक वडाहरुबाट एक महिलासहित तीन/तीन जनाका दरले २७ जना र नेपाल स्काउटबाट ५ जना गरी जम्मा ३२ जना सहभागी प्रशिक्षार्थीलाई विपद् व्यवस्थापनसम्बन्धी भूकम्प, बाढी, पहिरो, अग्नि नियन्त्रण, सडक दुर्घटना, भत्केका संचरनाहरुमा खोज तथा उद्धार, पानिमा खोज तथा उद्धार सम्बन्धी बिभिन्न सैद्धान्तिक तथा प्रयोगात्मक अभ्यासका साथ सशस्त्र प्रहरी बल, नेपालका १३ जना दक्ष प्रशिक्षकहरुद्वारा ५ र ६ गते गते प्रशिक्षण दिइने छ ।

सो कार्यक्रममा आन्तरिक मामिला तथा कानुन मन्त्री खनालले बर्षेनि हुने विपद्का कारण बागमती प्रदेशका बिभिन्न जिल्लाहरुमा धेरै मानवीय आर्थिक भौतिक क्षति हुँदै आइरहेकोमा सम्भाबित प्रकोपका घटनाबाट उत्पन्न विपद्को सामना गर्न तथा विपद्बाट हुन सक्ने जनधनको क्षति कम गर्न राज्यका सम्पूर्ण अंगहरुको अहम भूमिका रहने बताए । उनले सरकारी एवं गैर सरकारी कार्यालयहरु, विभिन्न संघ संस्था स्थानीय ब्यक्तिहरुले स्थानीय स्तरमा प्राप्त सिमित स्रोत साधनको उच्चतम प्रयोग गर्दै समन्वयात्मक ढंगबाट विपद् प्रभावित समुदायलाई तत्कालको उद्दारका लागि परिचालित हुनु पर्ने आवश्यकता औंल्याए । उनले दक्ष जनशक्ति उत्पादन गर्ने योजना अनुरुप पहिलो चरणमा मकवानपुर जिल्लाको मनहरी गाउँपालिकामा सशस्त्र प्रहरी बल, नेपालका दक्ष प्रशिक्षक कर्मचारीहरुद्वारा विपद् व्यवस्थापन अभिमुखीकरण तालिम सञ्चालन हुन गइरहेको र मकवानपुर जिल्लाका अन्य पालिकाका साथ साथै चितवन र सिन्धुपाल्चोक जिल्लामा समेत यस प्रकारका तालिम सञ्चालन गर्ने जानकारी गराए ।

मकवानपुर जिल्लाका निमित्त प्रमुख जिल्ला अधिकारी बद्रीनाथ गैह्रेले प्राकृतिक बिपत्ति आफै नआउने भन्दै यो मानिसद्वारा प्रकृतिमाथि गरिएको अप्राकृतिक कार्य अथवा दोहनका कारण निम्तिने बताए । उनले विपद्का घटनाबाट जनधनको क्षतिलाई न्यूनिकरण गर्न सकिने र यसका लागि यस प्रकारका अभिमुखिकरण तालिमले स्थानीय तहमा विपद् व्यवस्थापन सम्बन्धी ज्ञान र सीपयुक्त स्वयम् सेवक उत्पादन गरी विपद्बाट हुन सक्ने क्षतीलाई न्यूनिकरण गर्न ठूलो सहयोग पुग्ने बताए ।

आन्तरिक मामिला तथा कानुन मन्त्रालयका सचिव नारायणप्रसाद शर्माले विपद्को अवस्थामा विपद् न्यूनीकरणलाई थप टेवा पु¥याउने उद्देश्यका साथ आन्तरिक मामिला तथा कानुन मन्त्रालयले विभिन्न सम्बद्ध पक्षसँग सहकार्य गर्दै अगाडि बढ्ने बताए । उनले तालिमद्वारा नै समाजमा एक अनुशासित र दक्ष जनशक्ति उपलब्ध हुने र तालिममा सिकेका सीपले व्यक्ति, परिवार, समाज र राष्ट्रलाई फाइदा पुग्ने हुँदा यस प्रकारको राष्ट्रिय कार्यमा पर्याप्त रुपमा पहलता लिई अवधारणापत्र तयार गरी यस कार्यको थालनी गर्ने सशस्त्र प्रहरी बल, नेपाल नं ३ गढीमाई बाहिनी मुख्यालय मकवानपुर र सशस्त्र प्रहरी बल नेपाल नं. १४ गण हे.क्वा. मकवानपुर परिवारप्रति धन्यवाद ज्ञापन गरे ।

सो गाउँपालिकाका अध्यक्ष रन्जन कालाखेतीले विपद व्यवस्थापनलाई पनि योजनामा पारी कार्य गरेमा विपद्मा हुने क्षतीलाई न्यूनिकरण गर्न यस्ता किसिमका कार्यक्रमहरु फलदायी हुने र यस्ता तालिमले आपतकालीन अवस्थामा विपद् न्यूनिकरण गर्नमा ठुलो मद्दत पुग्ने बताए ।

सो तालिमको महत्व’bout प्रकाश पार्दै सशस्त्र प्रहरी बल, नेपाल नं. १४ गण हे.क्वा. मकवानपुरका गणपति सशस्त्र प्रहरी उपरीक्षक नेत्रबहादुर कार्कीले प्राकृतिक विपद् रोक्न नसके पनि घटना भएको स्थानमा सही समयमा स्थानीय स्तरमा ‘फस्ट रेस्पोन्डर’ को रुपमा ज्ञान र सीप हासिल गरेको ब्यक्ति उपलब्ध भएमा क्षति न्यूनीकरणमा सहयोग पु¥याउने बताए । उनले तालिम प्राप्त फौज आइपुग्न लाग्ने समयमा हुन सक्ने क्षतिलाई कम गर्ने मुल उद्देश्य स्वरुप यो तालिम सञ्चालन गरिएको र यसलाई निरन्तरता दिदै यो आर्थिक वर्षभित्र मकवानपुर जिल्लाका ५ वटा स्थानीय तहमा सञ्चालन गरिने बताए ।

title: बिरामी आमालाई भेट्न हिँडेका छोराको भिरबाट लडेर मृत्यु : RajdhaniDaily.com
article_text:
बझाङ । बझाङमा विरामी आमालाई भेट्न हिडेका छोराको भिरबाट लडेर मृत्यु भएको छ । सुर्मा गाउँपालिका वडा नम्बर ५ का ३३ बर्षिया लडे जेठाराको मृत्यु भएको उनका आफन्त चक्र बहादुर बोहराले बताए ।

घरमा ७३ बर्षिया आमा गदि देवि बोहरा गम्भिर विरामी भएको खबर पाएपछि यार्सा संकलन गर्ने ठाउँ पार्थीबाट घरका लागि हिडेका थिए । घर फर्किने क्रममा हलेलीको भिरबाट लडेर बेपत्ता भएका जेठाराको शुक्रबार विहान मृत अवस्थामा शब फेला परेको बोहराले जानकारी दिए ।

यार्सा संकलनकै क्रममा यस बर्ष सुर्मा गाउँपालिका मात्रै मात्रै ६ जनाले ज्यान गुमाएका छन् । भिरको बाटो साँघुरो र अफ्ठेरो भएका कारण भिरबाट लडेर र चिसोले कठ्याङ्रिएर तथा हिमपहिरोमा परी बर्षै पिच्छे मृत्यु हुने गरेको वडा नम्बर १ का वडा अध्यक्ष दिनेश बहादुर बोहराले जानकारी दिए ।

title: सङ्खुवासभामा हेवाखोलाको बाढीले बगाउँदा एक जनाको मृत्यु, १७ जना सम्पर्कविहीन : RajdhaniDaily.com
article_text:
सङ्खुवासभा । संखुवासभामा गएराती आएको बाढीले बगाउँदा एक जनाको मृत्यु भएको छ । जिल्लाको हेवा खोला बाढीले बगाएर ल्याएको अवस्थामा पाँचखपन नगरपालिका ५ मा एकजनाको शव भेटिएको जिल्ला प्रहरी कार्यालय सङ्खुवासभाले जनाएको छ । शवको पहिचान हुन सकेको छैन ।

चैनपुर नगरपालिका ४ पेङ्कोट र पाँचखपन नगरपालिका ९ मा गएको पहिरोले खोला थुनिएपछि आएको बाढीले बगाउँदा ठुलो जनधनको क्षति भएको हो । बाढीले चैनपुर ४ मा निर्माण भइरहेको सुपर हेँवा हाइड्रोमा पुर्णरुपले क्षति पुगेको छ ।

सो परियोजनामा काम गर्ने १७ मजदुरहरू सम्पर्कविहीन रहेको वाना प्रहरी चौकी प्रमुख टिकाराम राईले जानकारी दिए । खोलामा बाढी आएपछि उनीहरू अन्यत्र भागेको वा बाढीमा परेको भनेर यकिन हुन बाँकी रहेको राईले बताए ।

बाढीले पाँचखपन र चैनपुर जोड्ने निर्माणाधीन मोटरेबल पुल पनि बगाएको छ भने किनार क्षेत्रमा ४ घर बगाएको जिल्ला प्रहरी कार्यालय जनाएको छ । घटनाको थप विवरण आउन बाँकी छ ।

title: बेपत्ताको शव नभेटिएपछि कुशको शव बनाएर दाहसंस्कार : RajdhaniDaily.com
article_text:
ताप्लेजुङ । गएको शनिबार राति पहिरोमा परेर बेपत्ता बनेका ताप्लेजुङको सिदिङ्वा गाउँपालिकास्थित मेहेलेका तीन जना अझै नभेटिएपछि उनीहरूका आफन्तले कुशको शव बनाई दाहसंस्कार गरेका छन् ।

बेपत्ता बनेका एकै परिवारका तीन जनालाई शुक्रबार बिहानसम्म खोजी गर्दा पनि नभेटिएपछि दिउँसो कुशको शव बनाएर आफन्तले दाहसंस्कार गरेका हुन् । बेपत्ता भएदेखि नै आफन्त र स्थानीयसहित सुरक्षाकर्मीले खोजी जारी राखेका थिए ।

पहिराले घर बगाउँदा मेहेलेको भालुखोपका ६३ वर्षीया भगीमाया बुढाक्षेत्री, बुहारी ३० वर्षीया सन्ध्या र नाति ९ वर्षीय प्रज्वल बुढाक्षेत्री बेपत्ता छन् । पहिरोमा परी मेहेलेकै तीन जनाको निधन भएको छ ।

title: Two persons of a single family missing in Taplejung landslide
article_text:
Taplejung, June 17 (RSS): Two persons of a family have gone missing in a landslide that occurred last night at Khewang village in Sirijunga Rural Municipality-7, Taplejung.

Tulsa Adhikari and her daughter-in-law Yeshoda Adhikari are missing in the landslide that happened at around 8:30 pm while Yeshoda's husband Bishnu Adhikari saved his life, escaping the incident, according to Laxman Adhikari, a local resident in the village.

The landslide has swept away two houses of the Adhikari family and buried all the livestock as well. Details of the incident are awaited. Likewise, heavy landslides have occurred at different places in the district following the torrential rainfall.

title: 26 goats perish after flash flood, mudslide buries shed in Humla
article_text:
Simkot (Humla), April 17: Twenty-six goats have perished after a flashflood along with mudslide triggered by heavy rain buried a goat shed at Adanchuli Rural Municipality-3 in Humla district today.

Of the 70 goats inside the shed of Aite Budha of Adanchuli-3, 26 were buried by flood and landslide. Farmer Budha said that 26 goats were killed as the goat shed collapsed due to the mudslide.

He said that 29 goats inside the shed were rescued with the help of locals. The remaining goats are missing and a search is on for finding the missing goats. The torrential rain this morning has wreaked havoc at various places of the Adanchuli rural municipality.

According to journalist Mohan Singh Budha, 11 shops, one house and one sheep shed have been washed away in the floods triggered by incessant rains.

The torrential rain in the morning damaged the goods kept in the shops, including temporary tents of businessmen in local Srinagar town.

According to them, the flash flood has damaged the shops of Amrit Budha of Adanchuli-2, Buddhi Mahatara of Adanchuli-1 and others. The locals have been affected by the mud entering the houses and sheds of most of the people here. (RSS)

title: Husband killed, wife injured in Syangja landslide - The Himalayan Times - Nepal's No.1 English Daily Newspaper | Nepal News, Latest Politics, Business, World, Sports, Entertainment, Travel, Life Style News
article_text:
POKHARA: A person died while his spouse sustained injures after a landslide buried their house in Galyang Municipality-1 of Syangja district on Sunday morning.

The landslide caused by a heavy continuous downpour buried the house at around 3:00 am today, killing Yam Bahadur BK (49) while injuring his wife Phulmaya Bk (42), informed Deputy Superintendent (DSP) at the District Police Office, Rajendra Adhikari.

Severely injured Phulmaya was rushed to Lumbini Medical College in Palpa where she is receiving treatment, informed police.

However, it has been learnt that their two children, a son and a daughter, who were inside the house at the time of the incident, are safe.

title: Jajarkot road caves-in, over dozen households at risk of landslide - The Himalayan Times - Nepal's No.1 English Daily Newspaper | Nepal News, Latest Politics, Business, World, Sports, Entertainment, Travel, Life Style News
article_text:
JAJARKOT: The road that links the bus park in Khalanga, the Jajarkot district headquarters, with Rimna has caved-in today due to the incessant rainfall last night.

The rainfall-triggered landslide that occurred this morning has also swept away the poles installed for extending the central electrical transmission line. Subsequently, the vehicular movement along the road has come to halt.

Although, the landslides have occurred in various places in the district headquarters, the massive landslide in Thanti Bazar and Bahunbara in Bheri Municipality-3 and 4 respectively, have brought more than dozen households under threat of the landslip, forcing locals to move to safer places.

The houses under the risk of landslide belong to Bhadra Bahadur Bali, Bhadra Bahadur Khatri, Lok Bahadur Khatri, Tej Bahadur Khatri, Dhanasara Shahi, Ganesh Thapa, Hari Bahadur Basnet, Harka Bahadur Khadka among others.
